name: @babelize/mcp

tools.name: babelize_analyze
tools.description: Start here to make a React, Next.js or Django app global-ready (Vue, React Native/Expo and static HTML are beta). Scans the local project with the Babelize engine in dry-run mode on a temp copy: nothing is written, no network, no API key. Reports: framework and support level; whether the i18n library (next-intl / react-i18next / vue-i18n) is installed and wired up; hardcoded user-facing strings (count + file:line); JSX sentences kept whole as one ICU message vs split into pieces; strings that cannot be wired automatically and why; hardcoded dates/currencies/plurals; existing locale files and their coverage per locale; source keys that look unused (advisory); and next steps. Loop: babelize_analyze → babelize_translate → babelize_check (or babelize_review on a diff) → fix → repeat. Returns a short summary plus compact JSON; lists are capped by `limit`. Paths are relative to the project root.

path.description: Project directory, relative to the workspace root (default: the workspace root). Must stay inside the workspace.

locales.description: Target locales you plan to ship, e.g. ["de","ja"]; coverage is reported for them.

tools.name: babelize_translate
tools.description: Make the app global-ready: extract hardcoded strings, wire them to the i18n library (adding config/provider and package.json deps when missing), and translate every key into the target locales, writing locale files and code into the working tree. Same engine and result as `npx babelize translate`. Run babelize_analyze first; afterwards review `git diff` and run babelize_check. Requires a git repo with a clean working tree (commit or stash first; force: true overrides; dryRun: true previews without writing and works on a dirty tree). Incremental: a lockfile (.babelize/local/babelize-lock.json) means reruns only translate new or changed strings, and failed strings are retried on the next run. Earlier locales are kept and updated unless replace: true. Translation keys come from the MCP server environment, never from arguments: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY (your own LLM key), or a Babelize API key for Babelize-hosted translation (free tier): --api-key on this server, BABELIZE_API_KEY, or apiKey in .babelize/config.json. Returns files changed, per-locale translated/failed counts, failures with reasons, QA warnings, strings not wired into code, a diff summary (and a diff preview on dryRun). Sends progress notifications.

path.description: Project directory, relative to the workspace root (default: the workspace root). Must stay inside the workspace.

dryRun.description: Compute everything, write nothing; returns the diff summary and a preview. Still calls the translator (uses tokens).

force.description: Run on a dirty working tree (the result is then mixed with your uncommitted changes).

replace.description: Treat `to` as the full locale list: remove earlier locales not listed.

provider.description: Default: the first BYOK key found in the environment, then BABELIZE_API_KEY.

model.description: Model override for your own LLM key (not for babelize).

formality.description: Form of address per target locale (or base language), e.g. {"de":"formal","it":"informal"}. Merged over .babelize/config.json formality; unlisted locales are auto (what is conventional for software).

brandVoice.description: Tone and style for the translator, e.g. "Friendly, concise, no jargon". Replaces .babelize/config.json brandVoice for this run.

tools.name: babelize_check
tools.description: QA of the existing locale files against the source locale, without translating: no network, no API key, read-only. Use after babelize_translate or after editing locale files, and before committing. Finds: missing and stale keys; empty values; values identical to the source (untranslated); placeholders/tags lost or invented ({name}, {{count}}, <0>, %s); invalid ICU messages and wrong plural categories for the locale (ICU and i18next _one/_other keys); glossary violations (glossary in .babelize/config.json). Looks for <locale>.json (or <locale>/<namespace>.json) under locales/, messages/, lang/, i18n/ or translations/ folders. Returns per-locale counts and a capped list of issues (errors first) with file, locale, key and the problem in plain words.

path.description: Project directory, relative to the workspace root (default: the workspace root). Must stay inside the workspace.

locales.description: Only check these target locales (default: every locale file found).

minSeverity.description: Lowest severity to list (default "warning"; counts always include everything).

tools.name: babelize_review
tools.description: Review the locale changes in the current git diff (working tree vs HEAD, including untracked files) or vs a base ref, e.g. before committing or in a PR. QAs only the changed entries with the same checks as babelize_check (missing keys, placeholders, ICU, plural forms, untranslated, glossary from .babelize/config.json), and flags source strings whose translations were not updated (stale) and new source keys a locale is missing. Read-only; no network, no API key.

path.description: Project directory, relative to the workspace root (default: the workspace root). Must stay inside the workspace.

base.description: Branch, tag or commit to compare with (default HEAD, i.e. uncommitted changes), e.g. "main" or "origin/main".

tools.name: babelize_scan
tools.description: Low-level: list hardcoded strings in a local directory (regex/AST scan, no framework detection). No API key required. For a whole-project localization report use babelize_analyze.

tools.name: babelize_scan_strings
tools.description: Low-level: extract hardcoded translatable strings from a code snippet. No API key required.

tools.name: babelize_project_list
tools.description: Cloud project management: List all translation projects. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_project_get
tools.description: Cloud project management: Get details of a specific translation project. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_project_create
tools.description: Cloud project management: Create a new translation project from a GitHub repository (repo_url is required). ZIP projects cannot be created here: their archive must be uploaded first, via the dashboard (Upload ZIP) or `babelize init --source zip`. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

repo_url.description: GitHub repository URL, e.g. https://github.com/org/repo. Required.

tools.name: babelize_babel_list
tools.description: Cloud project management: List translation runs (babels). Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_babel_get
tools.description: Cloud project management: Get detailed info and logs for a translation run. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_language_list
tools.description: Cloud project management: List all supported languages. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_language_codes
tools.description: Cloud project management: Look up language code mappings (ISO ↔ FLORES-200). Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_engine_analyze
tools.description: Cloud project management: Analyze source code for framework detection and i18n readiness. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_tm_get
tools.description: Cloud project management: List translation memory entries for a project. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_tm_set
tools.description: Cloud project management: Add a translation memory entry. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_tm_export
tools.description: Cloud project management: Export translation memory as TMX. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_glossary_delete
tools.description: Cloud project management: Delete a glossary entry. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_glossary_import
tools.description: Cloud project management: Bulk import glossary entries from a CSV string (term,type,<locale>,…). Existing terms (matched ignoring case) are updated unless skip_existing is set. Reports added/updated/skipped/rejected rows. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

skip_existing.description: Only add new terms; leave existing ones unchanged

tools.name: babelize_glossary_export
tools.description: Cloud project management: Export glossary entries as CSV. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_project_language_add
tools.description: Cloud project management: Add a language to a project. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_project_language_remove
tools.description: Cloud project management: Remove a language from a project. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_member_list
tools.description: Cloud project management: List members of a project. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_invitation_send
tools.description: Cloud project management: Send a team invitation to a project. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_project_sync
tools.description: Cloud project management: Trigger a repository sync for a project. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_pr_raise
tools.description: Cloud project management: Create a GitHub Pull Request with the latest run's translations. If the project's PR is still open (same target languages), the run is added to it instead. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

title.description: PR title (default names the translated languages)

base_branch.description: Branch to open the PR against; must exist (default: the project's branch)

force_new.description: Open a new PR even if one is still open (replaces the link to it)

tools.name: babelize_pr_update
tools.description: Cloud project management: Push the latest run's translations to the project's open GitHub Pull Request. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_project_download
tools.description: Cloud project management: Download translated project files as ZIP. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

output_path.description: Directory to save the ZIP file (defaults to system temp dir)

tools.name: babelize_me
tools.description: Cloud project management: Get current user profile and credits. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_provider_tokens_list
tools.description: Cloud project management: List connected BYOK translation provider tokens. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_run
tools.description: Cloud project management: Trigger a Babelize translation run for target languages. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_run_and_wait
tools.description: Cloud project management: Start a translation run and poll until it completes. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

max_polls.description: Max number of polls before timeout (default: 120 = 10min)

tools.name: babelize_status
tools.description: Cloud project management: Check status of a translation run. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_glossary_get
tools.description: Cloud project management: List glossary entries for a project, with each entry's id (for babelize_glossary_delete) and the total count. Paged: 100 entries per page by default. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

tools.name: babelize_glossary_set
tools.description: Cloud project management: Add or update a glossary entry. never_translate keeps the term as written in every language (no target needed). always_translate_as sets the required translation of the term for one locale; calling it again for another locale adds that locale to the same entry. An existing entry for the term (matched ignoring case) is updated, not duplicated. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

source.description: The term in the source language

locale.description: Target locale of the translation, e.g. "fr" or "pt-BR" (always_translate_as only)
